title: Speaking Practice 15 - Describe a Book That Influenced You
description: IELTS Speaking Part 2: Describe a book that has had a big influence on you.

stimuli.title: Part 2: Describe a Book That Influenced You
stimuli.content:
You will have 1 minute to prepare and then speak for 1-2 minutes.

Describe a book that has had a big influence on you.

You should say: what the book is about, when you read it, why you chose to read it, and explain how it influenced you.

questionGroups.instruction: Speak for 1-2 minutes using the prompts.

questions.content: Describe a book that has had a big influence on you.

explanation.sampleAnswer: The book that influenced me most is Atomic Habits by James Clear. I read it during my second year of university when I was struggling with productivity. The book taught me that small, consistent changes can lead to remarkable results over time. Since reading it, I have built better study habits and exercise routines.
explanation.tips: Name the specific book and explain impact

questions.content: Do you think people read less nowadays?

explanation.sampleAnswer: In terms of books, perhaps yes. But people actually read more than ever if you count social media posts, articles, and messages.
Yes, but they should let students choose what they read rather than only assigning classics that might not engage young readers.
